areas.narrativeSummary: The school sets out curriculum intent around an Early Years Curriculum [3], and publishes a safeguarding, PSHE and RHE curriculum map for 2024–2025 [2]. Its useful websites page signposts curriculum support such as the Hit the Button maths game [1]. Long-term plans, a curriculum overview and Year R materials are listed among the school's curriculum offerings [3].

areas.narrativeSummary: Parent guidance on attendance includes information on education supervision orders [1]. A parent guide to special educational needs encourages limiting screen time and attending meetings such as parents' evenings, phonics sessions, transitions and SEN discussions, noting that the best results come when home and school work together [2].
